title: EMA Policy Gradient: Taming Reinforcement Learning for LLMs with EMA Anchor and Top-k KL
abstract: arXiv:2602.04417v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has enabled Large Language Models (LLMs) to acquire increasingly complex reasoning and agentic behaviors. In this work, we propose two simple techniques to improve policy gradient algorithms for LLMs. First, we replace the fixed anchor policy during RL with an Exponential Moving Average (EMA), similar to a target network in deep Q-learning. Second, we introduce Top-$k$ KL estimator, which allows for flexible interpolation between exact KL and sampled KL. We derive the stability conditions for using EMA anchor; moreover, we show that our Top-$k$ KL estimator yields both unbiased KL values and unbiased gradients at any $k$, while bringing the benefits of exact KL. When combined with GRPO, the two techniques (EMA-PG) lead to a significant performance boost. translated_title: EMA策略梯度：利用EMA锚点与Top-k KL驯服大语言模型的强化学习
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）已使大语言模型（LLM）能够掌握日益复杂的推理和智能体行为。在本工作中，我们提出两种简单的技术来改进面向大语言模型的策略梯度算法。首先，我们用指数移动平均（EMA）替换强化学习过程中的固定锚点策略，这类似于深度Q学习中的目标网络。其次，我们引入Top-$k$ KL估计器，它允许在精确KL与采样KL之间进行灵活插值。我们推导了使用EMA锚点的稳定性条件；此外，我们证明了Top-$k$ KL估计器在任意$k$值下都能产生无偏的KL值和无偏的梯度，同时兼具精确KL的优势。将这两种技术与GRPO相结合（EMA-PG）可带来显著的性能提升。在数学推理方面，它使R1蒸馏的Qwen-1.5B在OlympiadBench上达到53.9%，而GRPO为50.8%。在智能体强化学习领域，使用Qwen-3B……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出EMA锚点策略和Top-k KL估计器两项简单技术来改进大语言模型的策略梯度算法，结合GRPO后在数学推理和智能体强化学习任务上取得显著性能提升。
en_tdlr: Proposes two simple techniques—an EMA anchor policy and a Top-k KL estimator—to improve policy gradient algorithms for LLMs, significantly boosting performance over GRPO on math reasoning and agentic RL tasks.
